description: NaSbO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaSbO₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.45 Å. Sb is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
